new_schedule.target_order: Earliest actually known business not yet dispatched, including loading. A loading/previously-submitted next target cannot be skipped for a later waiting job.
new_schedule.source_gate: All local physical requests must have actual delivered terminal acknowledgments. Received E 5->1 transfers also retain the pre-existing strict ACK delivered_at + .5 < now headway proof. No future peer/private state is read.
retry_signature: locally owned physical request terminal flags and delivered ACK bodies
new_schedule.retry_rejected_when: The same signature has already been tried, two opportunities have already been used, or only time has advanced.
new_schedule.target_finished_when: ResidentWorker.submit returns an actual request id after a validated detached current collection. A refused collection leaves the target unconsumed.
new_schedule.no_local_L: Preview is a non-executing proposal and may use trigger_tray=None. Its real fresh A/B collection must still reconstruct all carriers. No invented local L or generation is admitted.
new_schedule.default_behavior: Worker polling remains nonblocking. An actual target load deadline cancels unfinished preview collection; default policy continues. Late results are rejected and each eligible body is consumed once.
new_schedule.scope: Only async scheduling and its declared plan contract change. Current route guard, candidate mask, immutable paired reference, physical domain, guarded mode ranking and source TTL remain unchanged.
new_schedule.audit_log: preview_schedule records deferral, bounded attempt, refusal and successful worker submission.
